scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n web,api,admin,app -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:app"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently -n api,app -c magenta,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm --prefix frontoffice run dev"
scripts.build:app: node scripts/prepare-frontoffice-build.mjs && npm install --prefix frontoffice && npm --prefix frontoffice run build
scripts.build:prod: npm run build && npm run build:admin && npm run build:app && node scripts/sync-static.mjs && next build
